groups.activity: earn a Death Mark, then meet Stalker

rows.label: Dread Blueprint
rows.note: 32.40% from base Stalker, 20.66% from Shadow/Protector Stalker; untradeable

conditions: Only the killing blow on an Assassination boss earns the mark; taxied players who haven't unlocked that planet get none.
Spawn chance is 1.5% + 0.5% per marked squad member (2% solo, 3.5% with four marked), arriving 30-280s in; past about 5 minutes he isn't coming.
He cannot spawn in Assassination, Syndicate, Archwing, Free Roam, Arena, Sortie, Archon Hunt, quest or Mastery Test missions, relays, Albrecht's Laboratories, Höllvania or Dark Refractory missions.
Warframes below rank 10 block the spawn entirely.
Before The Second Dream, base Stalker drops Dread more often (32.4% vs 20.66%): farm him now if you're early.
bonuses: Hyena Pack (Psamathe, Neptune) gives a separate mark per Hyena, stacking several in one solo run.
The Sergeant (Iliad, Phobos) is the fastest single-mark node; Volt with Shocking Speed, Gauss or Titania clear it fast.
Make missions last 4-5 minutes (Defense, Survival, Mobile Defense, relic runs) instead of blitzing: a full squad with everyone marked gives the best non-beacon rate.
Stay at range so he uses Dread instead of Hate/Despair, and stop shooting when he casts Absorb.
Beacons (Baro Ki'Teer only, 125,000 cr + 200 Ducats) force the spawn: worth it for Dread specifically, since even Hate/Despair beacon-hunters mostly pull Dreads as bycatch.

disclosures.title: the common Stalker drop
disclosures.body: Dread is by far the most common thing Stalker carries: expect it in about 3 to 4 kills, 17 to 29 near-guaranteed. People farming Hate, Despair or War for years keep getting Dreads instead; one reported 21 Dreads from 24 beacons.

disclosures.title: skip the bundle for Dread alone
disclosures.body: The What Stalker? Market bundle gets recommended for completionists, but for Dread by itself it's poor value next to a couple of kills.
